# SCIM `Groups` API reference

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:intro -->
This topic provides reference information for the public SCIM group provisioning endpoints under `/scim/v2/Groups`.

For documentation about the admin endpoint that lists provisioned groups for team mapping, refer to [Admin SCIM Groups API](/terraform/enterprise/api-docs/admin/scim-groups).

Refer to the [Public SCIM API](/terraform/enterprise/api-docs/scim) for shared authentication, discovery endpoints, pagination, supported filters, and shared rate limits.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:intro -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:intro -->
This topic provides reference information for the SCIM group provisioning endpoints under `/scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups`.

Refer to the [SCIM API](/terraform/cloud-docs/api-docs/scim) for shared authentication, discovery endpoints, pagination, supported filters, and rate limits.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:intro -->

## List SCIM groups

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:list-groups -->
`GET /scim/v2/Groups`

This endpoint returns SCIM groups provisioned into Terraform Enterprise.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:list-groups -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:list-groups -->
`GET /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups`

This endpoint returns SCIM groups provisioned into the organization.

### Path parameters

| Parameter              | Description                                                         |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration.         |

<!-- END: TFC:only name:list-groups -->

### Query parameters

| Parameter            | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `filter`             |         | Optional SCIM filter. Supported values are `displayName eq "value"` and `externalId eq "value"`. `displayName` matching is case-insensitive and `externalId` matching is exact. |
| `excludedAttributes` |         | Optional comma-separated list of attributes to omit from the response. Use `excludedAttributes=members` to omit group membership data.                                          |
| `startIndex`         | `1`     | The first record to return.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `count`              | `100`   | The maximum number of records to return. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:count-cap -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:count-cap --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:count-cap -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:count-cap --> caps this value at `200`. Set `count=0` to return only `totalResults`.                                            |

### Response codes

The following table describes response codes <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product --> returns. 

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                             |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 list response  | Successfully listed SCIM groups                    |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Unsupported filter expression or malformed request |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token       |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while listing SCIM groups           |

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:list-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request GET \
  "https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Groups?filter=displayName%20eq%20%22Engineering%22"
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:list-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:list-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request GET \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Groups?filter=displayName%20eq%20%22Engineering%22"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:list-sample-request -->

```json
				}
```

## Show a SCIM group

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:show-path -->
`GET /scim/v2/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:show-path -->
<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:show-path -->
`GET /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFC:only name:show-path -->

This endpoint returns a single SCIM group resource.

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:show-path-params -->
| Parameter | Description                                           |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM group ID returned in the group's `id` field. |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:show-path-params -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:show-path-params -->
| Parameter              | Description                                                         |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration.         |
| `:id`                  | The SCIM group ID returned in the group's `id` field.               |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:show-path-params -->

### Query parameters

| Parameter            | Description                                                                                                                            |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `excludedAttributes` | Optional comma-separated list of attributes to omit from the response. Use `excludedAttributes=members` to omit group membership data. |

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                       |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 group resource | Successfully returned the group              |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 -->                   |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Group not found                              |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                          |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while loading the group       |

## Create a SCIM group

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:create-groups -->
`POST /scim/v2/Groups`

This endpoint provisions a new SCIM group. You can optionally include initial members. 

Group member references must use existing Terraform Enterprise SCIM user IDs.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:create-groups -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:create-groups -->
`POST /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups`

This endpoint provisions a new SCIM group and automatically creates and links a team with the same name in the organization. 

You can optionally include initial members. Group member references must use existing HCP Terraform SCIM user IDs.

The group name `owners` and `sso` are reserved so you should not use either one as a `displayName`. Requests using these names return HTTP `409 Conflict`. Refer to [Existing HCP Terraform teams](/terraform/cloud-docs/scim/groups#existing-hcp-terraform-teams) for more information.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:create-groups -->

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:show-path-params -->
| Parameter              | Description                                                         |
| ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration.         |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:show-path-params -->

### Response codes

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                                   |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| [201][] | SCIM 2.0 group resource | Successfully created the group                           |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Malformed JSON or missing `displayName`                  |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token             |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Referenced SCIM user not found                           |
| [409][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | A group with the same `displayName` already exists       |
| [413][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Request body too large or group exceeds the member limit |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                      |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while creating the group                  |

### Request body

This endpoint accepts a SCIM 2.0 `Group` resource in the request body.

Properties without a default value are required.

| Key path          | Type   | Default | Description                                                                       |
| ----------------- | ------ | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemas[]`       | array  |         | Include `"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"`.                          |
| `displayName`     | string |         | The SCIM group name. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:displayname-uniqueness -->Terraform Enterprise enforces uniqueness case-insensitively.<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:displayname-uniqueness --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:displayname-uniqueness -->HCP Terraform enforces uniqueness case-insensitively.<!-- END: TFC:only name:displayname-uniqueness --> |
| `externalId`      | string |         | Optional identity-provider identifier for the group.                              |
| `members[]`       | array  | `[]`    | Optional initial group membership list.                                           |
| `members[].value` | string |         | A <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:scim-user-id -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:scim-user-id --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:scim-user-id -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:scim-user-id --> SCIM user ID to include in the group. |

### Sample payload

```json
{
	"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
	"displayName": "Engineering",
	"externalId": "ext-eng-001",
	"members": [
		{
			"value": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
		}
	]
}
```

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:create-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Accept: application/scim+json" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  --request POST \
  --data @payload.json \
  https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Groups
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:create-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:create-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Accept: application/scim+json" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  --request POST \
  --data @payload.json \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Groups"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:create-sample-request -->

### Sample response


## Replace a SCIM group

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-path -->
`PUT /scim/v2/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-path -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:replace-path -->
`PUT /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFC:only name:replace-path -->

This endpoint replaces the group's attributes and membership. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name --> treats `members` as the complete roster for the group. Setting `members` to an empty array clears the group's membership. If the request omits `members`, `displayName`, or `externalId`, <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name --> leaves the existing value unchanged.

| Parameter | Description                                           |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM group ID returned in the group's `id` field. |

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                                   |
| ------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 group resource | Successfully replaced the group                          |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Malformed JSON or invalid request body                   |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token             |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Group or referenced SCIM user not found                  |
| [409][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | A conflicting `displayName` already exists               |
| [413][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Request body too large or group exceeds the member limit |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                      |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while replacing the group                 |

### Request body

This endpoint accepts the same SCIM `Group` resource body shape as [Create a SCIM group](#create-a-scim-group).

### Sample Payload

```json
{
	"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
	"displayName": "Engineering",
	"externalId": "ext-eng-001",
	"members": [
		{
			"value": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
		}
	]
}
```

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request PUT \
  --data @payload.json \
  https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:replace-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:replace-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request PUT \
  --data @payload.json \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Groups/ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:replace-sample-request -->

## Patch a SCIM group

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-path -->
`PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-path -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:patch-path -->
`PATCH /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFC:only name:patch-path -->

This endpoint partially updates a SCIM group with a SCIM `PatchOp` request body. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name --> supports both full-member replacement and incremental add or remove operations.

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-path-params -->
| Parameter | Description                                           |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM group ID returned in the group's `id` field. |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-path-params -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:patch-path-params -->
| Parameter                | Description                                               |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration. |
| `:id`                    | The SCIM group ID returned in the group's `id` field.     |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:patch-path-params -->

### Response codes

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                                              |
| ------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [200][] | SCIM 2.0 group resource | Successfully updated the group                                      |
| [400][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Malformed JSON, unsupported PATCH operation, or too many operations |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token                        |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is disabled or paused                                          |
| [404][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Group or referenced SCIM user not found                             |
| [409][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | A conflicting `displayName` already exists                          |
| [413][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Request body too large or group exceeds the member limit            |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                                 |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while updating the group                             |

### Request body

| Key path             | Type   | Description                                                                                                                      |
| -------------------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemas[]`          | array  | Include `"urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"`.                                                                       |
| `Operations[]`       | array  | Up to 100 patch operations.                                                                                                      |
| `Operations[].op`    | string | Supported values are `Add`, `Replace`, and `Remove`.                                                                             |
| `Operations[].path`  | string | Supported targeted paths are `members`, `displayName`, and `externalId`. `Remove` supports `members[value eq "<scim-user-id>"]`. |
| `Operations[].value` | mixed  | The replacement value, added value, or bulk attribute object.                                                                    |

You can use the following `PATCH` operations:

- `Add` on `members`, where `value` contains one or more SCIM user IDs.
- `Remove` on `members[value eq "<scim-user-id>"]`.
- `Replace` on `displayName`, `externalId`, and `members`.
- `Replace` without a `path`, where `value` is an object containing any combination of `displayName`, `externalId`, and `members`.

Removing a member that is not currently in the group succeeds without error.

### Sample payload

```json
{
	"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
	"Operations": [
		{
			"op": "Add",
			"path": "members",
			"value": [
				{
					"value": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126"
				}
			]
		}
	]
}
```

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request PATCH \
  --data @payload.json \
  https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:patch-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:patch-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --request PATCH \
  --data @payload.json \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Groups/ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:patch-sample-request -->


### Sample response

```json

	"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
	"id": "ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88",

	"members": [
		{
			"value": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126",
```

## Delete a SCIM group

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-path -->
`DELETE /scim/v2/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-path -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:delete-path -->
`DELETE /scim/v2/:scim_configuration_id/Groups/:id`
<!-- END: TFC:only name:delete-path -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-prose -->
This endpoint deletes a SCIM group. Terraform Enterprise treats delete as idempotent and returns HTTP `204 No Content` whether or not the group exists.

If the deleted group is configured as the site admin group, Terraform Enterprise clears the site admin group mapping but does not revoke site administrator access that SCIM already granted.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-prose -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:delete-prose -->
This endpoint deletes a SCIM group and the linked team in the organization. HCP Terraform treats delete as idempotent and returns HTTP `204 No Content` whether or not the group exists.

Refer to [Groups lifecycle](/terraform/cloud-docs/scim/groups) for more information.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:delete-prose -->

### Path parameters

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-path-params -->
| Parameter | Description                                           |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `:id`     | The SCIM group ID returned in the group's `id` field. |
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-path-params -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:delete-path-params -->
| Parameter                | Description                                               |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:scim_configuration_id` | The external ID of the organization's SCIM configuration. |
| `:id`                    | The SCIM group ID returned in the group's `id` field.     |
<!-- END: TFC:only name:delete-path-params -->

### Response codes

| Status  | Response                | Reason                                                     |
| ------- | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| [204][] | No Content              | Successfully deleted the group, or the group did not exist |
| [401][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Missing, invalid, expired, or non-SCIM token               |
| [403][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | SCIM is <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:403 -->disabled or paused<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:403 --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:403 -->disabled<!-- END: TFC:only name:403 --> |
| [429][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Rate limit exceeded                                        |
| [500][] | SCIM 2.0 error response | Internal error while deleting the group                    |

### Sample request

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request DELETE \
  https://tfe.example.com/scim/v2/Groups/ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88
```
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:delete-sample-request -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:delete-sample-request -->
```shell
$ curl \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  --request DELETE \
  "https://app.terraform.io/scim/v2/$SCIM_CONFIGURATION_ID/Groups/ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88"
```
<!-- END: TFC:only name:delete-sample-request -->

### Sample response

A successful request returns a `204 No Content` response with no body.

## Response Attributes
<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->
Terraform Enterprise returns the following attributes in a SCIM group resource.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->
<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->
HCP Terraform returns the following attributes in a SCIM group resource.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name -->

| Attribute           | Type      | Description                                                                               |
| ------------------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `schemas[]`         | array     | Always includes `"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"`.                          |
| `id`                | string    | The SCIM group ID returned by <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name -->. |
| `externalId`        | string    | The identity-provider identifier stored for the group.                                    |
| `displayName`       | string    | The stored group name. <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name --> preserves the provided casing. |
| `members[]`         | array     | The current group membership. Omitted when the request uses `excludedAttributes=members`. |
| `members[].value`   | string    | A <!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name -->Terraform Enterprise<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:product-name --><!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:product-name -->HCP Terraform<!-- END: TFC:only name:product-name --> SCIM user ID. |
| `members[].display` | string    | The SCIM `userName` for the referenced member.                                            |
| `meta.resourceType` | string    | Always `"Group"`.                                                                         |
| `meta.created`      | timestamp | The time the group was created.                                                           |
| `meta.lastModified` | timestamp | The time the group was last updated.                                                      |

### Sample SCIM group resource

```json
{
	"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
	"id": "ef498761-2cc7-4569-9bd9-970a270dbb88",
	"externalId": "ext-eng-001",
	"displayName": "Engineering",
	"members": [
		{
			"value": "52f5ecb9-59db-4f8d-9c9b-c2ec9a39e126",
			"display": "jane.doe@idp.com"
		}
	],
	"meta": {
		"resourceType": "Group",
		"created": "2026-01-15T10:30:00Z",
		"lastModified": "2026-01-15T10:30:00Z"
	}
}
```

## Rate limiting

<!-- BEGIN: TFEnterprise:only name:rate-limit -->
The public `/scim/v2/Users` and `/scim/v2/Groups` endpoints share a default rate limit of 10 requests per second. When you exceed this limit, Terraform Enterprise returns HTTP [429][] with a `Retry-After` header.
<!-- END: TFEnterprise:only name:rate-limit -->

<!-- BEGIN: TFC:only name:rate-limit -->
The SCIM provisioning endpoints share a default rate limit of 30 requests per second. When you exceed this limit, HCP Terraform returns HTTP [429][] with a `Retry-After` header.
<!-- END: TFC:only name:rate-limit -->
